note: Delegated-task trace and resumable records (libs/core/workforce/delegated-task-observability.ts): a registered tier/tenant-partitioned runtime ledger root (PARTITIONED_RUNTIME_LEDGER_ROOTS.delegations, store role delegation_record_store). system/ holds untenanted delegations; confidential/<tenant>/ holds tenant delegations (instruction, context and result text) — delegations.jsonl (append-only audit trace), records/<id>.json, records/child-inbox/<child>.jsonl and notifications.jsonl (the background-completion notification queue of libs/core/mission/delegation-notifications.ts: tenant instruction/result excerpts; claimed rows are kept as the delivered-once ledger). Tenant partitions are tenant_scope protected prefixes, read and written only as the tenant-bound delegation_record_store role; tenant offboarding exports and soft-deletes a tenant's partitions (target kind tenant_delegations). Records are the resume authority for continuable child sessions, so removal is a reviewed decision.
